assumptions: A-CONTROLS-001: boundary is the organizer's provisional polygon, not an official redline; recalculate when official geometry is supplied.
A-GEO-007: green-space polygons are OSM-derived and may be incomplete; this ratio is indicative and does not support a statutory green-ratio conclusion.
A-GEO-007: derived from OSM point and polygon data; indicative only.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and the official site boundary are not present in the public site package.

assumptions: A-GEO-001: segment xiaoyuehe-seg-07 falls outside the coordinated research scope and is included in this total as background course length.
A-GEO-007: OSM-derived centreline; culverted sections are inferred from tagging, not survey.

xiaoyuehe_segments_in_design_scope.formula: count(EXISTING_WATER segments whose vertices test inside the overall design scope polygon)
assumptions: Point-in-polygon test against the organizer's provisional boundary; 5 of 8 segments qualify.
A-GEO-004: 28 reverse-tagged cycleway*=no entries were removed before counting.
A-GEO-004: crowd-sourced linework; not verified segment by segment on the ground.

cycleway_near_river_300m_segments.formula: count(ROAD_CENTERLINE segments whose distance to the EXISTING_WATER union is <= 300 m in EPSG:4548)
assumptions: A-GEO-004: supersedes the earlier draft count of 26, which predated full linework.

cycleway_near_river_300m_length_m.formula: sum(line_length) over the 42 segments within 300 m of the watercourse

cycleway_network_connected_components.formula: count(connected_components(graph)) where the graph is built by planarizing all ROAD_CENTERLINE segments at intersections and snapping endpoints within 8 m, in EPSG:4548
assumptions: A-NET-001: the count is dependent on the 8 m snapping tolerance, which is a method choice.
A-NET-002: gaps of under ~15 m may be OSM mapping artefacts rather than physical breaks.

cycleway_largest_component_length_m.formula: sum(edge_length) over the largest connected component
assumptions: A-NET-001: tolerance-dependent.
A-NET-001: tolerance-dependent.

gap_closure_length_m.formula: sum of the three shortest inter-component gaps: 9 m + 12 m + 35 m
assumptions: A-NET-002: whether these three gaps are real physical breaks or mapping artefacts is unverified; project JZ-07 is scoped as field verification first.
A-NET-003: topological only; says nothing about kerb gradient, clear width, or physical passability.

gap_closure_unlocked_network_m.formula: sum(component_length) over components joinable to the largest component through a gap of <= 200 m (21.58 km + 3.54 km + 5.10 km)
assumptions: A-NET-002: a hypothesis to be tested on site, not a design conclusion.
A-GEO-007: OSM POIs; the list is not an exhaustive register of elderly-care provision in the area.

elderly_facilities_network_reachable.formula: count(SCENARIO_NODE facilities in the same connected component as the candidate depot and within 100 m of a graph node)
assumptions: A-NET-004: measured from a single candidate depot, the node in the largest component closest to the watercourse (22 m from the river); the result is depot-dependent.
A-NET-003: topological reachability only.

elderly_facilities_within_100m_of_legal_.formula: count(SCENARIO_NODE facilities whose straight-line distance to any ROAD_CENTERLINE is <= 100 m)
assumptions: Straight-line measure. It is reported alongside elderly_facilities_network_reachable precisely to show the gap between as-the-crow-flies proximity and network reachability.

A-GEO-005: filtered to institutions inside the coordinated research scope, which is broader than 'adjacent to the site'; 8 faculty- and room-level sub-facilities were removed so every entry is an institution in its own right.
One entry (university-existing-18988158) carries no Chinese name in the source data and is included in this count.

universities_within_100m_of_legal_lane.formula: count(PUBLIC_SPACE institutions whose straight-line distance to any ROAD_CENTERLINE is <= 100 m)
assumptions: A-GEO-005: straight-line measure over all 50 institutions.

robot_service_network_10min_m.formula: sum(edge_length) reachable within 2,500 m of the candidate depot along the graph, i.e. 10 minutes at the 15 km/h regulatory ceiling
assumptions: A-NET-004: depot-dependent.
The binding constraint is network fragmentation, not the speed limit; a connected network would raise this figure substantially at the same 15 km/h.
